_note: v2 hook overrides for la Halle aux poids (B60_balance). Source hooks are kept where the painting shows them; these replace hooks whose painted scene differs (no text or numbers, no weapons).

fr_part_noun.hook: "PAHR": everyone on a PAR: the boy cuts the pie into a fair SHARE for each friend, one PART each.
fr_part_noun.why: A boy in an apron cuts the pie; no golfer is painted.

fr_chiffre_noun.hook: "SHEEFR" ≈ SHEAF + ruh: a golden SHEAF of wheat wears a tag with the DIGIT 7 — un chiffre is a digit, a figure.
fr_chiffre_noun.why: RECS pack 4 double-hook fix: one pun per word (SHEAF + ruh, as in ecole/pupitre); chef repainted as a wheat sheaf with a 7 tag.

fr_statistique_noun.hook: "stah-tees-TEEK": the owl perches by a TEAK panel carved with a row of little figures: a STATISTIC carved in TEAK.
fr_statistique_noun.why: The teak panel shows carved figures, with no numbers or bars written on it.

fr_majorite_noun.hook: "ma-zhor-ee-TAY": the gray-mustached army MAJOR beams as the children raise their hands: the MAJORITY vote yes.
fr_majorite_noun.why: The uniformed cat was repainted as a human army major; the kittens are now children.

fr_proportion_noun.hook: "pro-por-SYOHN": the PRO pie-cutter slices every PORTION the same size: perfect PROPORTION.
fr_proportion_noun.why: The painting shows a boy cutting the pie into equal portions instead of a baker at a scale.

fr_plupart_noun.hook: "plew-PAHR": on the top shelf, MOST of the flock (la PLUPART) are fluffy white sheep: "PLEW!" cries one, PART of the crowd.
fr_plupart_noun.why: Most of the sheep on the shelf are white; the pie is used for la proportion.

fr_dose_noun.hook: "DOHZ": the cook pours one DOSE of red syrup into a spoon while the gray cat DOZES beside her.
fr_dose_noun.why: A cook at the counter instead of a pharmacist.

fr_precision_noun.hook: the young jeweler in her green apron sets one grain on the little balance with tweezers, with PRECISION; the fly waits to SEE.
fr_precision_noun.why: A mouse jeweler instead of a lady.

fr_profondeur_noun.hook: "pro-fon-DUR": the boy measures the DEPTH of the well with his rope, and the cat, FOND of wells, PURRs over the edge.
fr_profondeur_noun.why: A boy instead of a girl.

fr_seuil_noun.hook: "SUHY": the cat knocks over a bottle of SOY sauce and a dark puddle spreads right across the THRESHOLD. le seuil = the threshold.
fr_seuil_noun.why: RECS pack 5 §2.1 rewrite; painted in the comptes repaint.

fr_quantite_noun.hook: "kahn-tee-TAY": a giant CAN of TEA spills leaves all over the counter: what a QUANTITY!
fr_quantite_noun.why: The tea can stands on the counter instead of on scales.

fr_exclusion_noun.hook: "ex-klew-ZYOHN": a red rope keeps the little elephant OUT, and he looks hurt: his EXCLUSION.
fr_exclusion_noun.why: A rope barrier only, with no sign or writing.

fr_attribution_noun.hook: "a-tree-bew-SYOHN": the girl cuts A TREAT for each guest, one equal slice per plate: a fair ALLOCATION of cake.
fr_attribution_noun.why: A girl cuts the cake into equal slices on the counter.

fr_affectation_noun.hook: "a-fek-ta-SYOHN" (false friend): not affectation but an ASSIGNMENT: the new worker beams as she gets her little desk and her badge.

fr_variation_noun.hook: "va-rya-SYOHN": like English VARIATION: a row of natural cats in every VARIATION: tabby, spotted, fluffy gray, sleek black and ginger-and-white.
fr_variation_noun.why: Five different natural cats sit in a row.

fr_trimestre_noun.hook: "tree-MESTR": at the end of TERM the TREE makes a MESS of its blank papers, scattered all around.
fr_trimestre_noun.why: The tree has no cap and the papers are blank.

fr_participe_noun.hook: "par-tee-SEEP": at the grammar PARTY, with balloons, the boy holds up his blank jigsaw-piece card: a PARTICIPLE fits into the sentence.
fr_participe_noun.why: The card is a blank jigsaw piece with no writing.

fr_fortement_adv.hook: "for-tuh-MAHN": the strong boy, a little FORT MAN, heaves a heavy anvil STRONGLY over his head.
fr_fortement_adv.why: An anvil instead of a cannon.

fr_enormement_adv.hook: "ay-norm-ay-MAHN": "Ay, NORM!": the boy presses down ENORMOUSLY hard on the little scale.
fr_enormement_adv.why: A boy pressing a small scale instead of a giant.

fr_entierement_adv.hook: "ahn-tyair-MAHN": the mouse ate the cheese ENTIRELY and lies ON his back in the empty pan with only the rind left.

fr_presque_adv.hook: "PRESK": the cook PRESSes the garlic press over a bowl: the garlic is ALMOST through.

fr_aussi_adv.hook: "oh-SEE": "Oh, SEE?" say the twins: one has a balloon, and her sister has one TOO.
fr_aussi_adv.why: The twins share the balloon scene.

fr_autrement_adv.hook: "oh-truh-MAHN": the little footbridge is shut, so the OTTER-MAN floats round it OTHERWISE.

fr_davantage_adv.hook: "dah-vahn-TAHZH": in the tug-of-war one team has the ADVANTAGE: it has MORE players on the rope. davantage = more.
fr_davantage_adv.why: RECS pack 5 §2.1 rewrite; cageot ice-cream girl repainted as a tug-of-war.

fr_distinctement_adv.hook: "dee-stank-tuh-MAHN": the balance DISTINCTLY tips toward the cake, not the carrot.

fr_exceptionnellement_adv.hook: "ek-sep-syo-nel-MAHN": an EXCEPTIONALLY heavy feather tips the magician's balance beside his top hat.

fr_remarquablement_adv.hook: "ruh-mar-ka-bluh-MAHN": a REMARKABLY big, perfect ladybird with bold round spots: what a MARK!

fr_exagerement_adv.hook: "eg-za-zhay-ray-MAHN": the boy angler holds up an EXAGGERATEDLY big fish: it was THIS big!
fr_exagerement_adv.why: He holds the fish instead of stretching his arms.

fr_partie_noun.hook: "par-TEE": a little PARTY of children marches past, each carrying one PART of the cake.
fr_partie_noun.why: The cake-carrying mice were repainted as children.

fr_entier_adj.hook: "ahn-TYAY": the little boy heaves the WHOLE cheese ON its stand, TEA cup on top: "YAY!"
fr_entier_adj.why: The mouse was repainted as a boy.

fr_morceau_noun.hook: "mor-SOH": the little girl hugging her cheese begs: "MORE, SO! One more PIECE!"
fr_morceau_noun.why: The mouse was repainted as a girl.

fr_concentration_noun.hook: "kohn-sahn-trah-SYOHN": tongue out, the little boy SAWS ("sahn") the cheese in total CONCENTRATION.
fr_concentration_noun.why: sawing mouse repainted as a boy

fr_aspect_noun.hook: "ahs-PEH": the girl turns the crystal to show every ASPECT: "ahs!" she gasps.

fr_melange_noun.hook: "may-LAHNZH": the boy tips the MELON in with the grapes and plums: one bowl, a MIXTURE.

fr_tellement_adv.hook: "tehl-MAHN": the little town crier has SO much to TELL, MAN: his scroll runs right off the counter.
fr_tellement_adv.why: mouse crier repainted as a boy

fr_exactement_adv.hook: "ehg-zahk-tuh-MAHN": the grandmother grocer adds one more EGG to the balance: EXACTLY right.
fr_exactement_adv.why: grocer mouse repainted as a grandmother

fr_egalement_adv.hook: "ay-gahl-MAHN": A GAL and A MAN (a girl and a boy) share the cherries EQUALLY, the same heap each.

fr_soixantaine_noun.hook: "swa-sahn-TEN": a SUAVE SANTA in sunglasses holds a cake crowded with ABOUT SIXTY candles.
fr_soixantaine_noun.why: Santa in sunglasses holds a cake packed with tiny candles.

fr_faculte_noun.hook: "fa-kewl-TAY": like English FACULTY: the little girl shows off her FACULTY for counting on the abacus.
fr_faculte_noun.why: A girl in a yellow dress slides abacus beads.

fr_maximum_noun.hook: "max-ee-MOM": the little weightlifter lifts the MAXIMUM, a giant sugar cube, and her MOM cheers.
fr_maximum_noun.why: A girl in a red leotard lifts a huge sugar cube while her mother claps.

fr_tristement_adv.hook: "treest-MAHN": TREES, the MAN... his bare TREES have lost every leaf, so the MAN sits SADLY beneath them.
fr_tristement_adv.why: A man sits sadly by a bare tree.

fr_hautement_adv.hook: "oht-MAHN": the little OAT MAN on stilts, a big sheaf of OATS under his arm, stands HIGH above everyone: HIGHLY visible.
fr_hautement_adv.why: A boy on tall stilts carries a sheaf of oats.

fr_approximativement_adv.hook: "a-prok-see-ma-teev-MAHN": the girl eyes the beans and shrugs: APPROXIMATELY a hundred.
fr_approximativement_adv.why: She shrugs at the bowl of beans.
